text:
How to build an award-winning scroll-animation website with zero code (FULL WALKTHROUGH)

Most people think the websites that win design awards need a Webflow expert, a motion designer, and a developer. Spent an evening pulling apart the exact tutorial a creator just published for one of these scroll-driven sites. 

No framework. No localhost. Everything on the cloud, most of it on a free plan.

Below is every prompt, in the order you paste it. Copy them as is.

STEP 1. Two frames, not one.

The whole effect is a video tied to scroll. A video needs a start frame and an end frame. Generate the scene in GPT image (or any image model), then ask for the second frame from the same world.

Frame one prompt:
"A cinematic hero scene: [your subject, e.g. a small plane gliding through soft clouds], natural light, aesthetic, award-winning web design quality, wide shot, empty space for text."

Frame two prompt (run on the same image):
"Zoom out from this exact scene and open it up [e.g. pull back so the plane is smaller and farther], keep the same colors, same clouds, same style, do not change anything else."

STEP 2. Animate the transition.

Drop both frames into Kling 3.0.

Prompt:
"animate this smooth transition from frame one to frame two, natural and aesthetic scene"

Set 10 seconds, 1080p. Render the same two frames through Seedance 2 as well and keep whichever flies cleaner. Higgsfield is a third option.

STEP 3. Build the hero in Google AI Studio (free plan).

Go to motion-sites, copy any font prompt, delete everything except the font-family CSS (kill the mask-reveal block and the assets). Paste that stripped font into Google AI Studio, then this:

"Build me a hero section using the font CSS above. Text centered and at the top of the image, plain white background. The prompt I gave you is broken, I removed parts on purpose, just do your best with the font and create a clean responsive hero with a nav bar."

STEP 4. Build every section in one prompt.

No screenshots. Paste this:

"Below the hero section add these sections, using the fonts and styles we already established:
- About section: text on the left, image on the right.
- Feature section: headline, tagline, description, then two cards (one left, one right).
- Stats section: headline, description, then five numbers each with a short label.
- Footer."

STEP 5. The one line that triples the quality.

AI cramps every section by default. Paste this exactly:

"Every section should be 100vh. All sections should be 100vh each so they fill the full height of the screen and scale by viewport."

That single line is the gap between "AI website" and "agency website."

STEP 6. Wire the video to scroll.

On motion-sites, copy the full prompt, find the block labelled "video source and implementation," replace the video link with your Kling render. Paste it in with:

"Add this video and this scroll system to our page. Adapt it to fit our site, you can change the content and the position of the elements so the scroll effect looks good. Do whatever you need to make it look right."

STEP 7. Fix the two mistakes AI always makes.

It darkens the video and adds an overlay. Paste:

"Revert to the previous color scheme. I did not ask for dark mode. All text and buttons go back to their original color. The video should be 100% opacity with no overlays. Fix this, then I will tell you what is next."

Then the text is unreadable on the footage. Fix it with a mask, not a background:

"From the bottom of the page to about the middle, add a gradient from solid to transparent, and mask all page content to that gradient so the text and elements emerge out of the page as you scroll."

Now text rises from behind the scene like it is 3D, and it reads on mobile.

STEP 8. Scale to a full site.

Open Landbook, see how a page is structured, then describe the new page in your own words (about page, services, etc). Generate a fresh frame one and frame two per page so no two pages share a video, run it through Kling or Seedance, then paste:

"Only on the about page, use this video as the hero background with the same scroll effect, just change the link."

That is the whole system. image, animate, build, 100vh, mask. Repeat per page.

You do not need a developer. You need the order of operations.

Save this. Build one tonight.
content: animate this smooth transition from frame one to frame two, natural and aesthetic scene
